title: Lies Are A Gentleman's Manners
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Jonathan, a brash medical student in the United States, steals drugs from his school's hospital and sells them to classmates; when his professor Paul Haskins finds out, Jonathan agrees to a sexual relationship in exchange for silence (Juné blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). The professor has a wife, a child, a lover and a past, and the volume includes a story about his earlier relationships plus short extras (MangaUpdates). A one-volume adult boys'-love comedy-drama that its own blurb calls 'quirky' with 'questionable humor'.
life_message: It treats lies and appearances as how its high-society characters get by, while hinting that real feeling is hard to hide (to verify).

content.note: Explicit sex scenes between adult men, short but on-page (MangaUpdates user comments; AniList tags); relationship begins through blackmail; adultery by a married professor (MangaUpdates Adultery, Cheating).
